description: Mato Grosso Sul - Mapa temático de risco á erosão de solo is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). MSMapa temático de risco á erosão de solo estimada pela metodologia USLE. O mesmo está classificada em cinco ordens de perda de solo, sendo a classe 1 referente a perda de solo está na ordem 0 a 10 ton.ha/ano, a classe 2 de 10 a 20 ton.ha/ano, classe 3 é 20 a 50 ton.ha/ano; classe ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Global, South America, Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
